haugbui_piece_tomb_desc: A burial mound that binds an undead servant. It works for you at night.
haugbui_piece_offering_desc: Roasted boar meat and honey laid before the tomb. Strengthens its Haugbui.
haugbui_piece_treasure_desc: The coins and gems the dead one was buried with. Strengthens its Haugbui.
haugbui_piece_bracelets_desc: Arm rings of a chieftain. Strengthens its Haugbui.
haugbui_piece_longsword_desc: The blade of a fallen king. Its Haugbui will defend the burial place.
haugbui_piece_altar_desc: Dark energy that lets its Haugbui walk in daylight.
haugbui_piece_collection_desc: Items left here are put away by a Haugbui.
haugbui_piece_delivery_desc: A Haugbui brings the items you request to this chest.
haugbui_msg_api_check_failed: Haugbui: some features were disabled because the game changed. See the BepInEx log.
haugbui_msg_piece_disabled: Haugbui: a building piece was disabled because its recipe is invalid. See the BepInEx log.
haugbui_msg_need_bed: A tomb must be built near a bed you own.
haugbui_msg_need_tomb: Build this next to a Haugbui tomb.
haugbui_msg_upgrade_exists: The tomb nearby already has this.
haugbui_combat_warning_text: With this sword the Haugbui will defend its burial place at all costs, and its blows may damage your buildings. Combat stays off until you enable it in the tomb.
haugbui_activity_no_destination: keeping items: no chest holds them yet
haugbui_panel_partially_loaded: Part of the work area is not loaded ($1% loaded); objects there are ignored.
haugbui_activity_gathering: picking up items from the ground
haugbui_delivery_readonly: These requests could not be read and are kept untouched.
haugbui_delivery_err_full: This chest already has 10 request lines.
haugbui_delivery_err_save: The requests could not be saved.
haugbui_msg_max_tombs: Every Haugbui of yours already has a tomb.
haugbui_msg_offer_failed: You have none of that to offer.
haugbui_status_no_tribute: No tribute: offer valuables at the tomb
haugbui_status_no_slot: No Haugbui is bound to this tomb
haugbui_job_no_owner: No Haugbui has taken this job yet
haugbui_job_owner_away: Worked by a Haugbui whose tomb is not loaded
haugbui_job_no_tomb: No tomb has this station in its area
haugbui_job_needs_level: Production needs a tomb of level $1
haugbui_job_toggle_off: Production is turned off at the tomb
haugbui_job_finishing: finishing: waiting for the last products
haugbui_job_manual_use: paused: the station holds other items (manual use)
haugbui_msg_tomb_too_close_own: Too close to another of your tombs.
haugbui_job_too_close_to_dawn: waiting: too close to dawn to cook safely
haugbui_job_cooking_warning: Without the Altar it loads only what is done before dawn; items you leave cooking may burn.
